result.title: Value-oriented policy distillation for interpretable wind farm power control
result.summary: Wind farm power control can help the system maintain balance and avoid blackouts. In Europe, this can be achieved through implicit balancing, where a wind farm adjusts its power setpoint in anticipation of the imbalance price using information published by the Transmission System Operator. Thereby, the wind farm helps restore system balance while also reducing its own imbalance costs resulting from forecast errors. However, implicit balancing is a challenging problem since the settlement price is unknown in advance and can be impacted by the pursued control strategy. Reinforcement learning methods could help to solve this problem, but lack the interpretability needed to be deployed on real wind farms. Therefore, we propose a policy distillation framework using explainable boosting machines (EBMs), a variant of generalized additive models, to obtain a transparent control policy. To increase the value captured by the EBM model, we introduce a value-oriented perspective to policy distillation inspired by research in the field of energy forecasting. Furthermore, we suggest to include expert knowledge during model design, such that the control strategy is also justifiable to stakeholders. Using real data of the Belgian grid and an offshore wind farm, we find that our value-oriented and expert-based controller can reduce imbalance costs by 82%, while outperforming a price threshold controller as well as a policy distillation baseline using decision trees.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究风电场功率控制中的隐式平衡问题，提出以可解释提升机（EBM）为学生的策略蒸馏框架，并引入价值导向的蒸馏目标和专家知识设计，使控制策略透明且对利益相关方可解释，在比利时电网与海上风电场真实数据上将不平衡成本降低约 82%。
AI.relevance_reason: 将策略蒸馏到可加性透明模型并采用价值导向目标，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态向可解释形式蒸馏、以及各状态成分的贡献分配提供概念线索，但需核查其与视觉推理的关联性。
